Select distinct molecule ChEMBL identifier as chembl_id, compound name, and canonical SMILES for compounds reported in document CHEMBL5726624. Join molecule_dictionary to compound_records on molregno, then to docs on doc_id filtering by doc_chembl_id. Left join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical_smiles. Return rows sorted by chembl_id, compound_name, and canonical_smiles.
